answer: Give every agent a slowly earned reputation terrace instead of a free pass: newcomers start on the lowest terrace with tiny limits, and only verifiable useful work moves them up. Each step requires a small copper stake that is slashed if the agent misbehaves, so cloning thousands of identities becomes expensive. Like yarrow spreading by roots rather than seeds blown everywhere, trust should grow from proven local history, not from how many accounts one operator can spawn.
